summary.text: The dream path is the Gu path built to explore dream realms and handle dream path Gu, killer moves, and Immortal Gu.

claims.text: The novel names dream path as a cultivation path with mortal Gu, Immortal Gu, killer moves, and attainment ranks, not as a metaphor for sleep.

Dream realms expand whenever humans dream. After long accumulation they can surface into the outside world. Inside them, cultivators can obtain foundations left by ancient people, raise attainment rapidly, and recreate or invent Gu, recipes, and killer moves. To explore surfaced dream realms efficiently, many talents produce the needed Gu worms, and the newly discovered dream path forms and develops quickly.
Surfaced dream realms can be explored with dream path mortal Gu. Dream realms that have not surfaced require dream path Immortal Gu.
Fang Yuan’s first on-page recollection of the path pairs Dream Wings with dream path.

A common theory links control of the dream realm to becoming Great Dream Immortal Venerable, a figure said to transcend ordinary venerables by using the accumulations of past individuals. In Fang Yuan’s previous life he could enter dream realms with mortal dream path Gu but lagged without a dream path Immortal Gu, while large forces split the surfaced dream field among themselves. Named early Immortal Gu include Dream Travel, used by Lady Poison Scorpion, and Dream Wings tied to Feng Jin Huang and Spirit Affinity House.

Old Man Yan Shi compares his own human path attainment unfavorably with Ren Zu while discussing his Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique, which can live only eighteen hours and still loses soul memories under dream path dao marks.

Heavenly Court seeks Spectral Soul’s dream path research results, meaning the Pure Dream Reality Seeker Physique method that condenses dream realms into those physique bodies. Unravel mystery Immortal Gu, when advanced, can greatly increase the power of unravel dream and aid dream path cultivation.

Dragon Palace holds rank eight dream path Immortal Gu Dream Token. Its dream path killer moves include dreamy light smoke, which captures rather than simply offends, plus dream within dream and dream revelation. In the stretch when dream path is still ahead of the era, the Gu Immortal world and even Heavenly Court lack ready counters to such methods. Dragon Palace remains an enslavement path Immortal Gu House at root even with Dream Token aboard, and it lacks dream path defensive methods in that account.

Fang Yuan later holds rank seven Dream Armor, a defensive dream path Immortal Gu, while Dream Token remains his rank eight dream path Immortal Gu and Dragon Palace core. At that time dream path is still not developed enough for dream realms to manifest everywhere, so dream path immortal materials and Immortal Gu stay rare. Dream path killer moves often use other paths’ Immortal Gu as cores and fill gaps with dream path mortal Gu, as with lead soul into dream and switch soul in dream. Closed cultivation raises him to dream path master attainment, which improves instinctive judgment of Gu worm compatibility for killer moves. He still treats becoming venerable first as the condition for truly developing dream path at leisure, remembering previous-life dream path geniuses such as Feng Jin Huang and Lady Poison Scorpion.
